pages.text: A familiar ring is worn on the left hand. Three of them, no more.

pages.title: Calling
pages.text: I call one out with a word, and send it back with another. Only one answers at a time.$(br2)It follows me, fights what hurts me and what I strike, and comes through a rift when I am far or when I vanish. I named mine. I pet it, when nothing is watching.

pages.title: When It Falls
pages.text: A familiar that falls cracks its ring for three minutes. The maw mends it sooner, for Sorrow. Calling a bound familiar costs nothing.
